display: Kmodern service (NestJS application: DI, guards, filters, interceptors)
//: The fourth flavour, and §5.3 asks for it rather than tolerates it: 'tsconfig.base.json plus one
tsconfig.<flavour>.json per app type'. A NestJS service is an app type this repo has - it is not a
Node library, because it is the one workspace where a decorator is legal.
These two flags lived in apps/api/tsconfig.json, which is a compiler option redefined per
workspace while the other four workspaces sharing the Node flavour silently do not have them.
§5.3's instruction is 'change the base', so they moved here instead: apps/api now extends a
flavour like every other workspace does, and nothing else inherits them - the flags were checked
before moving, and only apps/api has any decorator at all (90 files; apps/scraper,
packages/contracts, packages/scraper-core, packages/transport and packages/ui each have zero),
so putting them in tsconfig.node.json would have turned on legacy decorator semantics for code
`emitDecoratorMetadata` is the one that is not a style choice: NestJS dependency injection reads
`design:paramtypes`, which only these flags produce. Without them the object graph builds and
then injects undefined into every constructor - a failure that boots.
